proof_body:
by
  intro H _ _ B c f v hc h hv
  by_cases h0 : ‖v‖ = 0
  · rw [h0, mul_zero]; exact norm_nonneg _
  have hp : 0 < ‖v‖ := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm h0)
  have h1 := h v
  rw [hv] at h1
  have h2 : f v ≤ ‖f‖ * ‖v‖ := (le_abs_self _).trans (f.le_opNorm v)
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right (h1.trans h2) hp
target_source: ∀ (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] (B : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : ℝ) (f : StrongDual ℝ H) (v : H), 0 < c → (∀ u, c * ‖u‖ * ‖u‖ ≤ B u u) → (∀ w, B v w = f w) → c * ‖v‖ ≤ ‖f‖
